analysis.summary: Management reported a strong start to FY27 with consolidated operating revenues of INR56.9 crores, registering a 22% year-on-year growth, and EBITDA increasing by 27% year-on-year to INR8.3 crores. The company successfully migrated from the SME platform to the main board of NSE on June 18, 2026. Management highlighted the continued growth of their patient support programs (PSP), healthcare camps, and Q-Devices portfolio as key strategic drivers. Furthermore, management expects to complete the acquisition of the remaining stake in subsidiary Saarathi Healthcare by the end of Q2 FY27. QMS Medical Allied Services reported a strong start to Q1 FY27 with a 22% YoY increase in revenue to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management guided for approximately INR90 crores to INR100 crores of service revenue visibility for the year.
guidance.quote: However, for now, you can consider that. And we've guided approximately INR90 crores to INR100 crores of service revenue visibility for this year.

guidance.claim: Management stated they would want to maintain the top-line guidance of around INR220 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: We would want to maintain that guidance because we just finished quarter 1, we are in mid of quarter 2.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects demand for their integrated and technology-enabled PSP platform to continue growing as pharmaceutical companies focus on patient access and adherence.
demand_outlook.quote: As pharmaceutical companies increasingly focused on improving patient access, adherence and outcomes we expect demand for our integrated and technology-enabled PSP platform to continue growing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects Q Devices to contribute 10% to 15% to the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: And we're looking at a 10% to 15% contribution coming from Q devices.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Products business continued to demonstrate healthy traction supported by the expanding distribution network, Q-Devices portfolio, and digital platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Products business continued to demonstrate healthy traction, supported by our expanding distribution network, Q-Devices portfolio and presence across QMSMEDS, e-Grameen and other digital platforms.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the Services business continued to emerge as a key growth engine driven by deeper pharma partnerships, increasing adoption of Patient Support Programs, and scaling healthcare camp operations.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, our Services business continued to emerge as a key growth engine, driven by deeper pharma partnerships, increasing adoption of Patient Support Programs and the scaling of our healthcare camp operations.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is progressing towards acquiring the remaining stake in Saarathi Healthcare, which they expect to complete by the end of quarter 2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently hold a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and are progressing towards acquiring the remaining stake, which we expect to complete by the end of quarter 2 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA grew 27% year-on-year to INR8.3 crores with EBITDA margin improving to 14.6%.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, our EBITDA grew faster than revenue, increasing 27% year on to INR8.3 crores with the EBITDA margin improving 14.6% compared with 14.1% in Q1 FY '26 and 13.3% in the Q4 FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT stood at around INR4 crores, growing 25% year-on-year with PAT margins improving to 7%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at around INR4 crores, growing 25% year-on-year. While our PAT margins have improved to 7%, the sequential performance is equally increasing.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the combined margins for services are estimated to be in the 20% to 25% range.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have a higher margin in camps and a lower margin in PSPs and the combined margins is what we estimate to be in 20% to 25% range.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved to 14.6% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We delivered revenue of Rs. 56.9 crore, growing 22% YoY, while EBITDA increased 27% YoY to Rs. 8.3 crore, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.6%.

orders_capacity.claim: During quarter 1 FY '27, the company conducted more than 11,497 B2B health camps.
orders_capacity.quote: We are very pleased to announce that we have conducted more than 11,497 B2B health camps in the Quarter 1 FY '27 demonstrating the depth of our field execution capabilities and the trust based on us by our profitable factors.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that their proprietary technology platform supports 100-plus programs and more than 1 million patients.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, our proprietary technology platform supports 100-plus programs and more than 1 million patients providing real brand tracking, monitoring, analytics and patient engagement capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company conducted 11,497 B2B health camps.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we also conducted 11,497 B2B health camps, demonstrating our growing execution capabilities and reach.

capital_allocation.claim: The company holds a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and expects to acquire the balance stake by the end of Q2FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We currently hold a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and expect to acquire the balance stake by the end of Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to complete the acquisition of the remaining stake in Saarathi Healthcare by the end of quarter 2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We currently hold a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and are progressing towards acquiring the remaining stake, which we expect to complete by the end of quarter 2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to acquire the balance stake in Saarathi Healthcare by the end of Q2FY27.
